research.title: Occlusion-Aware Feature Matching for Visual Correspondence
bullets: Formulated whether visibility estimates could distinguish unreliable correspondences from appearance changes, and led development of an occlusion-weighted feature matching objective.
Designed controlled evaluations using synthetic occlusions and viewpoint changes, comparing correspondence accuracy and confidence calibration against unweighted matching baselines.

research.title: Boundary-Aware Confidence Learning for Semantic Segmentation Under Domain Shift
bullets: Formulated how boundary uncertainty affects segmentation adaptation, and led development of confidence-weighted pseudo-labeling with spatial consistency constraints.
Developed boundary-sensitive calibration analyses and comparative experiments examining pseudo-label selection, consistency losses, and segmentation errors across appearance shifts.

work.title: Image Processing Service Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned image validation and resizing components, handling malformed uploads and preserving consistent output formats for downstream application services.
Added regression tests for image processing edge cases, investigated service failures, and documented component behavior during routine maintenance.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Classification Transfer Strategies
bullets: Implemented frozen-feature classification and full-network fine-tuning using pretrained convolutional models, with consistent preprocessing and matched training partitions.
Compared classification performance across limited-label settings, examining confusion patterns and sensitivity to augmentation choices using held-out validation data.

projects.title: Classical and Learned Stereo Matching
bullets: Implemented block matching and a convolutional stereo baseline, aligning disparity conventions and preprocessing across a shared image-pair evaluation pipeline.
Compared disparity errors in textured, reflective, and occluded regions, inspecting failure cases and the effects of matching-window size.

projects.title: Image Retrieval with Local and Global Descriptors
bullets: Implemented local-feature aggregation and pretrained global image embeddings for retrieval, applying consistent descriptor normalization and nearest-neighbor ranking procedures.
Evaluated retrieval rankings under cropping and illumination changes, comparing descriptor behavior through relevance metrics and qualitative inspection of mismatched images.

projects.title: Optical Flow Estimation Under Motion and Brightness Changes
bullets: Implemented a pyramidal gradient-based optical flow baseline and evaluated an existing learned estimator with shared frame preprocessing.
Compared endpoint errors across motion boundaries and brightness perturbations, documenting failure cases associated with large displacements and low-texture regions.
